gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kantumruy-pro: Round forms like open parentheses give Turret Road its bold, commanding face. Kantumruy Pro takes over below as a plain sans whose e opens clearly to the right, so body text can sit a size or two down without crowding.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kodchasan: Turret Road leads with round, parenthesis-shaped forms and a pen-like line that never changes weight. Kodchasan follows with terminals left hanging open and no calligraphic thinning, so long paragraphs read in a smooth, clean stream.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-koho: Commanding is how Turret Road lands, its pen-like line holding one weight from edge to edge in a flat gray hum. And KoHo, a clean sans with wide c apertures, gives that heft somewhere quieter to rest.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kosugi: Turret Road's round forms read like open parentheses, bold and sure. Kosugi brings an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers and a wire-bent look, and a modest body size lets that wiry line breathe.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kosugi-maru: Bold lettering up top, drawn with a pen-like line from Turret Road. Kosugi Maru is a plain sans of neon-tube letters with stroke ends set far apart, so a longer stretch glows along in one steady, contemporary line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-kumbh-sans: Kumbh Sans reads like a plain sans drawn with a fixed pen, its terminals cut well short of the bowl. Turret Road shouts above it in parenthesis-round display forms, and the two meet in a shared constant line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-lato: Lato reads clean and professional, its s curves wide and barely curled in. And Turret Road, with no hairlines to squint at, carries a bold weight above it, so a long page moves along without any strain.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-libre-franklin: Round, bold and pen-drawn, Turret Road has no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. Libre Franklin adds a splayed c terminal. Their shared directness is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-line-seed-jp: Turret Road opens with commanding, parenthesis-round forms drawn in a single pen-like line. And LINE Seed JP follows in a sans with horizontals as heavy as its verticals, its counters letting the eye slip in and out.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-livvic: Livvic reads clean and friendly, curves without stress and a generous opening in c. Make Turret Road small, or Livvic large, and the plain sans body and the bold display heading start to swap roles.
